name: Ibrahim
summary: The Grand Vizier. Pasha: +20% Production to all military units in the city.

fields.title: The Grand Vizier
fields.base_ability: Pasha: +20% Production to all military units in the city.
promotions: Tier 1 Head Falconer: All friendly units fighting within the city's territory gain +5 Combat Strength. (after Pasha)
Tier 1 Serasker: Grants all units within 10 tiles of the City Center +10 Combat Strength when attacking defensible districts. (after Pasha)
Tier 2 Khass-Oda-Bashi: When established in an allied foreign Capital, your Alliance Points with the owner increase an extra.5 per turn. (after Head Falconer)
Tier 2 Capou Agha: When established in a foreign Capital, Grievances from the city owner against you are reduced by 1 more per turn. (after Serasker)
Tier 3 Grand Vizier: When established in a foreign Capital, none of the owner's cities exert Loyalty pressure on your cities. (after Khass-Oda-Bashi or Capou Agha)
fields.description: Suleiman's vizier Ibrahim, is a Military and Diplomacy focused governor. In addition to having a unique promotion tree, Ibrahim is the only Governor that can be assigned to another civilization's capital as well as any domestic city. He is well suited for influencing military operations but is also a skilled diplomat, strengthening relationships with friendly civilizations and easing tensions with rivals.

name: Amani
summary: The Diplomat. Messenger: Can be assigned to a city-state, where she acts as 2 Envoys.

fields.title: The Diplomat
fields.base_ability: Messenger: Can be assigned to a city-state, where she acts as 2 Envoys.
promotions: Tier 1 Emissary: Other cities within 9 tiles and not owned by you lose 2 Loyalty per turn. (after Messenger)
Tier 1 Affluence: While established in a city-state, provides a copy of its Luxury resources to you. (after Messenger)
Tier 2 Local Informants: Enemy Spies operate at 3 levels below normal in this city. (after Emissary)
Tier 2 Foreign Investor: While established in a city-state, accumulate its Strategic resources. When suzerain receive double the amount of accumulated strategic resources. (after Affluence)
Tier 3 Puppeteer: While established in a city-state, doubles the number of Envoys you have there. (after Local Informants or Foreign Investor)
fields.description: Skilled in gaining support for your civilization, and spreading its influence to nearby cities. Amani is the only governor that can be given foreign assignment in a city-state.

name: Liang
summary: The Surveyor. Guildmaster: All Builders trained in this city will get +1 build charge.

fields.title: The Surveyor
fields.base_ability: Guildmaster: All Builders trained in this city will get +1 build charge.
promotions: Tier 1 Zoning Commissioner: +20% Production towards constructing districts in the city. (after Guildmaster)
Tier 1 Aquaculture: Can construct the Fishery improvement. +1 Food, +0.5 Housing, +1 Food if adjacent to a sea resource. +1 Production if Liang is in the city. (after Guildmaster)
Tier 2 Reinforced Materials: This city’s improvements, buildings, and districts cannot be damaged by Environmental Effects. (after Zoning Commissioner)
Tier 2 Water Works: +2 Housing for every Neighborhood and Aqueduct district in this city. +1 Amenity for every Canal and Dam district in this city. (after Aquaculture)

Tier 3 Parks and Recreation: Can construct the City Park improvement in this city. +1 Culture and +2 Appeal. +1 Amenity if adjacent to water. City Parks provide +3 Culture if Liang is in the city. (after Water Works or Reinforced Materials)
fields.description: An expert in efficiency, Liang is skilled in all things related to building and construction. An expert planner, she can also supervise the development of custom improvements in the city.

name: Moksha
summary: The Cardinal. Bishop: Religious pressure to adjacent cities is 100% stronger from this city. +2 Faith for every specialty district in this city.

fields.title: The Cardinal
fields.base_ability: Bishop: Religious pressure to adjacent cities is 100% stronger from this city. +2 Faith for every specialty district in this city.
promotions: Tier 1 Grand Inquisitor: +10 Religious Strength in theological combat in tiles of this city. (after Bishop)
Tier 1 Laying On Of Hands: All Governor's units heal fully in one turn in tiles of this city. (after Bishop)

Tier 2 Citadel of God: City ignores religious pressure from Religions not founded by the Governor's player. Gain Faith equal to 25% of the construction cost when finishing buildings. (after Grand Inquisitor or Laying On Of Hands)
Tier 3 Patron Saint: Apostles and Warrior Monks trained in the city receive 1 extra promotion when receiving their first promotion. (after Citadel of God)
Tier 3 Divine Architect: Allows city to purchase districts with Faith. (after Citadel of God)
fields.description: Spiritual and Religious leader that can increase the Religious Strength of a city, and the Religious units stationed there. Moksha is a beacon of Faith in your empire.

name: Victor
summary: The Castellan. Redoubt: Increases city garrison Combat Strength by +5. Establishes in 3 turns.

fields.title: The Castellan
fields.base_ability: Redoubt: Increases city garrison Combat Strength by +5. Establishes in 3 turns.
promotions: Tier 1 Garrison Commander: Units defending within the city's territory get +5 Combat Strength. Your other cities within 9 tiles gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization. (after Redoubt)
Tier 1 Defense Logistics: City cannot be put under siege. Accumulating Strategic resources in the city gain an additional +1 per turn. (after Redoubt)

Tier 2 Embrasure: City gains an additional Ranged Strike per turn. Military units trained in this city start with a free promotion that do not already start with a free promotion. (after Defense Logistics or Garrison Commander)
Tier 3 Air Defense Initiative: +25 Combat Strength to anti-air support units within the city's territory when defending against aircraft and ICBMs. (after Embrasure)
Tier 3 Arms Race Proponent: 30% Production increase to all nuclear armament projects in the city. (after Embrasure)
fields.description: Military focused, once established in a city, Victor is instrumental in strengthening, preserving, and defending it from foreign threats.

name: Pingala
summary: The Educator. Librarian: 15% increase in Science and Culture generated by the city.

fields.title: The Educator
fields.base_ability: Librarian: 15% increase in Science and Culture generated by the city.
promotions: Tier 1 Connoisseur: +1 Culture per turn for each Citizen in the city. (after Librarian)
Tier 1 Researcher: +1 Science per turn for each Citizen in the city. (after Librarian)
Tier 2 Grants: +100% Great People points generated per turn in the city. (after Connoisseur or Researcher)
Tier 3 Curator: +100% Tourism from Great Works of Art, Music, and Writing in the city. (after Grants)
Tier 3 Space Initiative: 30% Production increase to all space-program projects in the city. (after Grants)
fields.description: Pingala is focused on the cultivation of Scientific and Cultural endeavors in the city. He is also quite skilled in the attraction of Great People to his city.

name: Reyna
summary: The Financier. Land Acquisition: Acquire new tiles in city faster. +3 Gold per turn from each foreign Trade Route passing through the city.

fields.title: The Financier
fields.base_ability: Land Acquisition: Acquire new tiles in city faster. +3 Gold per turn from each foreign Trade Route passing through the city.
promotions: Tier 1 Harbormaster: Double adjacency bonuses from Commercial Hubs and Harbors in the city. (after Land Acquisition)
Tier 1 Forestry Management: This city receives +2 Gold from each unimproved feature. Tiles adjacent to unimproved features receive +1 Appeal in this city. (after Land Acquisition)
Tier 2 Tax Collector: +2 Gold per turn for each Citizen in the city. (after Harbormaster or Forestry Management)
Tier 3 Contractor: Allows city to purchase districts with Gold. (after Tax Collector)
Tier 3 Renewable Subsidizer: All Offshore Wind Farms, Solar Farms, Wind Farms, Geothermal Plants, and Hydroelectric Dams in this city receive +2 Power and +2 Gold. (after Tax Collector)
fields.description: Shrewd and fiscally knowledgeable, Reyna is able to strengthen the economic power of a city, using finances to provide more than is normally possible.

name: Magnus
summary: The Steward. Groundbreaker: +50% yields from plot harvests and feature removals in city.

fields.title: The Steward
fields.base_ability: Groundbreaker: +50% yields from plot harvests and feature removals in city.
promotions: Tier 1 Surplus Logistics: +20% Food Growth in the city. Your Trade Routes ending here provide +2 Food to their starting city. (after Groundbreaker)
Tier 1 Provision: Settlers trained in the city do not consume a Citizen Population. (after Groundbreaker)
Tier 2 Industrialist: Increases the Power provided by each resource of the Coal Power Plant, Oil Power Plant, and Nuclear Power Plant by 1 and the Production by +2. (after Surplus Logistics)
Tier 2 Black Marketeer: Strategic resource costs for units are discounted 80%. (after Provision)
Tier 3 Vertical Integration: This city receives Production from all nearby Industrial Zone buildings with regional bonuses, not just the first. (after Industrialist or Black Marketeer)
fields.description: Enterprising and capable, Magnus is able to procure valuable resources when needed. He is also quite skilled in optimizing the overall Production in the city.
